content.short: SolsWatch provides insights and charts for Solana NFT collections.
content.description: SolsWatch delivers in-depth insights and visual charts for Solana NFT collections. Users can track the latest floor prices, trade volume, and listing histories, and discover new collections as they appear on supported marketplaces. Developers can access the SolsWatch public API to integrate endpoints into their own applications. At present, SolsWatch supports nine marketplaces, with plans to add more marketplaces in the future.
